shortTitle: FDA Hypoglossal Nerve Stimulation Device Labeling
fullTitle: Current FDA PMA labeling map for implanted hypoglossal nerve stimulation systems used in obstructive sleep apnea
citation: U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Premarket Approval records for implanted hypoglossal nerve stimulation systems for obstructive sleep apnea; current PMA records verified August 8, 2026.
currencyNote: Current U.S. PMA landscape verified 2026-08-08 includes Inspire (P130008 family; expanded indication supplement S090), Genio System 2.1 (P240024; approved 2025-08-08), and aura6000 (P250013; approved 2026-03-18). FDA PMA pages explicitly warn that later supplements may change labeling, so current device-specific labeling must be rechecked.
bestFor: Regulatory/device-label context showing that upper-airway/hypoglossal stimulation is not one universal device pathway and that indications, exclusions, programming, and follow-up requirements are product-specific.

mappingRationale.D4B: Provides current regulatory context for upper-airway/hypoglossal stimulation without substituting a device label for an AASM treatment-selection guideline.

authorityBoundary: FDA PMA labeling governs device-specific approved use; it is not an AASM clinical practice guideline and is intentionally not promoted into the Guild's 15-rule AASM/AAST authority registry. Do not teach one manufacturer's AHI, BMI, age, anatomy, or PAP-history criteria as universal HNS eligibility. Verify the current FDA label and manufacturer instructions for the specific device.
copyrightUse: Use public regulatory identity, approval dates, indication categories, original summaries, and links. Do not reproduce full labeling, proprietary manuals, device figures, or substantial protected text.
